args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 – Saltmarsh summary
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by about a quarter. (Only a short preview was available without registering.)

Sources: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain ; https://insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion
